design.articulation: At successive distinct observed pictures, correlate signed change in mouth aperture with signed change in compressed speech level. A static arm uses aperture and RMS level.
design.bracket: Search 480, 640 and 880 ms middle intervals. Leave one tick between the middle and each 480 ms flank. Both flanks must favor a common lag over the changed lag.
design.agreement: Both measurements must pass on the same bracket, with a shared pair of lags.
design.point: For each arm use max(0.10, highest observed development control score + 0.03), then freeze.
design.useful: A reported interval overlaps the known shift by at least 0.40 IoU and signs and estimates the lag within 80 ms.
design.controls: Unchanged, gain, filtering, local noise, constant shifts and two matched picture and sound shifts. Matched picture controls reassign verified mouth observations on the same grid without re-encoding.
